classes.proof: says where a requirement is proven: through the door, at the real plane, with later modules' real screens, or names a test file another module owns
classes.wholeplane: one of plane's proofs of another (non-UI) module at the real plane
classes.order: states that one module is earlier or later than another, or forbids an import by order
classes.world: the test world and test door that stand in for the real door in UI tests
classes.text: an address, bound, sentence or sequence agreed between the door side and a screen
classes.cite: names the other side only to cite its requirement or what it does
classes.double: a UI requirement whose test names a fake or stub 'plane'
classes.generic: a UI requirement that uses 'the plane' for the server side as a whole
